items.t: FHP trooper airlifted to hospital after patrol car hit in Orange County construction zone
items.x: An FHP trooper was airlifted to hospital with serious injuries after their patrol car hit in SR-429 construction zone on Tuesday night.

items.t: Orlando weather: Rain chances remain for Central Florida
items.x: Passing showers will remain in the forecast Thursday and Friday with 20-30% chance for rain, especially during the daytime and afternoon hours.

items.t: Tuscana development near Shingle Creek sparks community outcry, town hall
items.x: Protect Shingle Creek is holding a community town hall Thursday at 6 p.m. at Somerset Village, 11425 Sandy Hill Dr., Orlando, to explain what comes next and what actions residents can still take.

items.t: Orange County Mayoral candidates face off during final debate
items.x: Candidates Chris Messina and Tiffany Moore-Russell debated ahead of the November 3 Orange County mayoral election.

items.t: Orlando Magic fall behind early in 129-99 loss to Toronto Raptors
items.x: The Orlando Magic fell 129-99 to the Toronto Raptors behind strong performances from RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes.

items.t: Earl the Squirrel will make a giant balloon debut at Macy’s parade
items.x: Universal Orlando's Earl the Squirrel is set to join the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade on Nov. 26 in New York City.

items.t: Manatee with lost flipper thriving at SeaWorld Orlando: 'A second chance'
items.x: A severely injured manatee named Southpaw is swimming and recovering at SeaWorld Orlando after a tangled crab trap forced veterinary teams to amputate her right flipper.

items.t: Downtown Orlando bar owners hope safety changes bring back Halloween crowds
items.x: Two years after a deadly Halloween shooting in downtown Orlando, bar owners are hoping enhanced security measures will help visitors feel confident returning for the holiday weekend.

items.t: Horror con Spooky Empire happens in Orlando over Halloween weekend
items.x: Horror con Spooky Empire, much like a good slasher-flick villain, is back for another installment in Orlando on Halloween weekend.

items.t: Man arrested, charged with murder in 2025 shooting, Orlando police say
items.x: Marcus Antoinne Lambert was charged with second-degree murder in a 2025 homicide investigation.

items.t: Florida Highway Patrol trooper hit, seriously hurt on SR 429 while guarding construction zone, FHP says
items.x: A Florida Highway Patrol trooper was seriously hurt and flown to a nearby hospital after his vehicle was hit on State Road 429 Tuesday night in Orange County, according to FHP. The other driver was also hurt and taken to the hospital.

items.t: FHP trooper seriously injured after pickup rear-ends patrol car on SR 429
items.x: A Florida Highway Patrol trooper and a pickup truck driver were seriously injured in a crash involving a marked patrol vehicle in a construction zone on State Road 429 in Orange County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

items.t: Genitorturers make Halloween heavy in Orlando

items.t: Court suggests Florida teacher shouldn’t be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk’s death
items.x: A Florida judge last week recommended dismissing a misconduct case against a Clay County teacher for a post celebrating Kirk's death.
